name: Emotional Scene
description: Declarative preset for interior change and relational rupture or repair. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Let feeling emerge from want, fear, and consequence rather than labels.
writing_goals: Name the want and the fear before the peak
Use body, gesture, and environment as evidence
Avoid summarizing the emotion the scene already shows
Leave a residual change in the relationship
constraints: Do not dump unprocessed trauma as spectacle
Do not resolve a long-running wound in a single unearned beat
Do not imitate a living author's sentimental register
checklist: A choice is made under feeling, not after it
Physical or environmental detail supports the peak
The aftermath is not identical to the start
